definitions.gloss: irreplaceable; one of a kind; having no substitute
definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone that cannot be replaced, because no substitute of equal value exists. The phrase is essentially a fixed collocation built on {代|か}わり ('substitute, replacement'), and is used to express deep emotional value, especially for people and meaningful things.

examples.japanese: {代|か}わりのない{友|とも}だち。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧{代|か}わりのない⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ。
examples.english: My family is irreplaceable to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧きた⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{万年筆|まんねんひつ}→万年筆：02968_mannenhitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧{代|か}わりのない⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧なものです。
examples.english: This fountain pen I've used for many years is a precious, irreplaceable thing to me.

notes:
A fixed attributive phrase built from ⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧ ('substitute, replacement') + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (genitive linker) + ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (negative of ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧). Literally 'having no substitute'. Used almost exclusively before a noun to describe people, relationships, or objects of deep personal value.

Grammatically an adjectival phrase; unlike a true na-adjective it cannot take な before the noun, and it does not inflect freely like an i-adjective (you do not say {代|か}わりのなく). For predicate use, speakers typically rephrase: {代|か}わりのない⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ (predicate) or ⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (statement).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代|か}わりのない⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an irreplaceable person
- {代|か}わりのない⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧: an irreplaceable presence/being
- {代|か}わりのない⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: irreplaceable time
- {代|か}わりのない⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧: irreplaceable memories
- {代|か}わりのない⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧: a life that cannot be replaced

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦かけがえのない→かけがえのない：10328_kakegaenonai⟧: irreplaceable, precious — a near-synonym, often slightly more literary/emotional
- ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}{無二|むに}→唯一無二：20617_yuiitsumuni⟧: one and only; unique — stronger, more formal
- ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧つとない: one of a kind, like no other — emphasizes rarity more than emotional bond
- ⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な: precious, valuable — broader; emphasizes value, not uniqueness
- {代|か}わりのない vs ⟦かけがえのない→かけがえのない：10328_kakegaenonai⟧: nearly interchangeable. ⟦かけがえのない→かけがえのない：10328_kakegaenonai⟧ is slightly more poetic and common in set phrases like ⟦かけがえのない→かけがえのない：10328_kakegaenonai⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧ ('precious life'); {代|か}わりのない feels slightly more conversational.
